description:
Register a pilot PBX; returns pbx_id + API key once (hashed at rest). ≤5/hour/IP → 429. Idle $0.

Control-plane register. API key shown once; stored hashed at rest. Send x-temsor-pbx-key to scope GET /v1/pbx/promises to this pbx_id. No speech recognition while idle.

ari_webhook_secret.description: ARI webhook signing secret (stored as hint only).

label.description: Human label, e.g. hotel or PBX/IT provider site.

pbx_id.description: Pilot PBX id; auto-minted if omitted.

webhook_events.description: Event list or comma string: promise.opened|closed, fact.extracted, orchestra.act, redact, or *.

webhook_secret.description: Optional HMAC secret for outbound webhook signatures (x-temsor-signature).

webhook_url.description: Optional outbound webhook URL — Temsor POSTs promise/fact/orchestra/redact events.

name: pbx_register
title: PBX Register
